name: gemini-quality-gate-jev
description: TypeSafe Jev gates for Gemini CLI: one correction pass after each answer, a risk guard before tool calls, a policy check before each request, and a session pre-flight advisory. The Jev API key is read from ${XDG_CONFIG_HOME:-~/.config}/typesafe/jev.env (written by install.sh) or the TYPESAFE_API_KEY environment variable.
